title: Calibration rejected: Sensor stopped
symptom: When putting a calibration into xDrip, it shows in the queue for the transmitter as the mg/dL equivalent, then a notification says 'Calibration rejected: unknown code 12' and halts the session with 'Insufficient calibration: G5 Sensor Stopped' notification. Calibrating on the receiver feeds over to xDrip within 3 cycles and it restarts.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user reported that turning off a smartwatch resolved the issue, and another user found that disabling Bluetooth and enabling 'go on without calibrations' settings helped, but no single cause is confirmed.
fix: Upgrade to May 10th nightly or above. One user reported that disabling Bluetooth for a few minutes and enabling the 'go on without calibrations' settings, then restarting the sensor, resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: I disabled Bluetooth for a few minutes and also enabled the 'go on without calibrations' settings. After restarting the sensor it warmed up 2hrs and since then works like a charm, including backfill!
